_note: Chiang Rai standing events, read by importers/harvest_events.py cr_standing_rows(). A rule is not a date: each occurrence inside horizon_days is projected from the weekday and marked from_rule. 'time' is set only when the sources read agree on it; otherwise the row is all-day and the description carries the range the sources give. 'source' is an id in data/sources.json (status curated), 'url' the page that states the rule, 'seen' the day it was read.

rules.title: Saturday Walking Street · ถนนคนเดินเชียงราย
rules.venue: ถนนคนเดินเชียงราย
rules.description: Weekly Thanalai Road market organised by Chiang Rai Municipality. The sources give opening at 15:00 or 16:00 and closing at 22:00 or 23:00 (lovethailand.org, thaiholidayguide.com, chiangraitimes.com, read 2026-10-10).

rules.title: Sunday Walking Street · Sankhong Happy Street
rules.description: Weekly food-led market on San Khong Noi Road, near Wat Chetuphon. The sources give the day and no hours (chiangraitimes.com, updated 2026-08-22; thaiholidayguide.com, reviewed 2026-07; read 2026-10-10).

rules.title: Chiang Rai Night Bazaar
rules.description: Daily market on Phahonyothin Road beside Bus Terminal 1. lovethailand.org gives 18:30–23:00; chiangraitimes.com gives opening at 17:00 or 18:00 and closing at 22:30 or 23:00 (read 2026-10-10).

rules.title: Clock Tower light and music show
rules.description: Chiang Rai Times reports shows at 19:00, 20:00 and 21:00, about 10 minutes each, at the Phahonyothin and Suk Sathit roundabout (page updated 2026-08-30, read 2026-10-10).
